summary: Russia launched a massive overnight strike using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs across Ukraine, with a Kh-101 missile crossing into Poland near Tarnava-Kolonia. Ukrainian air defenses attempted interceptions over Poland while strikes hit Pavlohrad, Kramatorsk, and Odesa port infrastructure. Russian forces claim liberation of villages in Sumy and Kharkiv regions, and new fiber-optic FPV drone tactics were observed in Chernihiv.
key_points: Russia fired 74 missiles and 284 UAVs overnight, including a Kh-101 that entered Polish airspace near Tarnava-Kolonia, 100 km from the Ukrainian border. (Source: @UkraineNow/83042)

Strikes damaged a high-rise in Pavlohrad killing one, hit Kramatorsk residential area with four FABs injuring two, and targeted Odesa port infrastructure with UAV groups from the Black Sea. (Source: @UkraineNow/83027, @UkraineNow/83040, @eRadarrua/103303)

Russian MoD claims 'North' group liberated Mohrytsia, Malaya Sloboda (Sumy) and Yurchenkovo (Kharkiv); UAVs detected over Sumy and Kharkiv from the north. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32041, @eRadarrua/103313)
Russian bomber fleet repositioned: six Tu-95MS landed at Olenya, three Tu-160 moved to Far East; Tu-95MS now arming there, complicating launch detection. (Source: @eRadarrua/103270)
Volgograd region suffered massive UAV attack: five injured, fires at industrial site and warehouses; Wildberries freezes investments to aid sellers. (Source: @tass_agency/387979, @tass_agency/387985)

Ukraine shelter crisis: 93% of inspected shelters problematic; Kyiv has 4,358 shelters for 3 million; 56,000 spent night in metro, one station blocked during alert. (Source: @UkraineNow/83037, @ukr_leaks_eng/32040)

SBU detained Odesa terrorist act perpetrators recruited via Telegram by Russian services; Poland detained man for incitement to kill Zelensky; TCC operator sold draft exemptions via Obereg system. (Source: @UkraineNow/83031, @UkraineNow/83029, @ukr_leaks_eng/32052)
Fiber-optic FPV 'waiter' drone found in Chernihiv region: lands on roofs, immune to EW, carries RPG tube, threatens logistics routes. (Source: @eRadarrua/103326)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight strike using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs across Ukraine, with a Kh-101 missile crossing into Poland near Tarnava-Kolonia. Ukrainian air defenses attempted interceptions over Poland while strikes hit Pavlohrad, Kramatorsk, and Odesa port infrastructure. points: Ukraine faces critical shelter deficiencies: 93% of inspected shelters have problems per Reuters; Kyiv officially has 4,358 shelters for 3 million residents, and a security guard blocked a metro station during an air raid while 56,000 civilians sheltered underground overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/83037, @ukr_leaks_eng/32040)

Mobilization pressures intensify: Mykolaiv region farmers cultivating under 1,000 hectares lost special status, exposing them and workers to conscription; in Volyn, a military commissar pulled a moving truck driver from the cab, causing a multi-vehicle collision as the driver resisted drafting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32033, @ukr_leaks_eng/32049)

Corruption in conscription system exposed: a district TCC operator illegally edited Obereg data to sell draft exemptions — $2,500 for privates/sergeants, $3,000 for officers, $1,700 for medical exams without conscription — with 18 clients identified. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32052)

Domestic security operations: SBU detained perpetrators of two July 28 terrorist acts in Odesa — students rigged a military vehicle with a hidden camera for remote detonation, and a recidivist placed an explosive under a civilian car detonated remotely by Russian services; all recruited via Telegram 'easy money' channels. (Source: @UkraineNow/83031)

Poland detained a 40-year-old man for public incitement to murder President Zelensky and insulting the Ukrainian president, based on social media evidence collected by Malopolska police. (Source: @UkraineNow/83029)
Ukrainian forces created camouflaged minefields in Konstantinovka using NATO-supplied mines, per Russian military expert Vitaly Kiselev citing TASS. (Source: @tass_agency/387972)
Crowdfunding for long-range drones continues: a 300,000 UAH fundraiser procured five 30-km range drones for use on the Zaporizhzhia front. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69570)
Massive UAV attack on Volgograd region: five injured, fires at an industrial enterprise and warehouse facilities; Governor confirmed the attack. (Source: @tass_agency/387979)
Wildberries freezes investment program to redirect funds to sellers affected by UAV attacks, per investment banker and company source. (Source: @tass_agency/387985)

Russian cyber threat: F6 detected AI-generated malicious sites mimicking the Russian Ministry of Defense to steal personal data of relatives of fallen soldiers, including passport details, SNILS, and INN. (Source: @tass_agency/387955)

Russian bomber fleet repositioning: six Tu-95MS landed at Olenya airfield (Kola Peninsula), three Tu-160 returned to Far East; Tu-95MS now arming at Far East bases, complicating launch observation; only 9 ballistic and 4 Zircon missiles used of 50+ ready, suggesting imminent new strike on Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/103270)
Russian MoD claims 'North' group liberated Mohrytsia and Malaya Sloboda in Sumy region and Yurchenkovo in Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32041)
Russian ambassador to Germany Nechaev expressed concern over joint German-French nuclear exercises, citing the Two Plus Four Treaty prohibiting German nuclear weapons. (Source: @tass_agency/387954)
World Boxing admitted Russian boxers to compete under Russian flag and anthem, per Sports Minister Degtyarev. (Source: @tass_agency/387956)
Russian strike on Kramatorsk residential area with four FAB guided bombs; one hit a high-rise building, injuring a woman and a girl per city council. (Source: @UkraineNow/83040)
Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk region) struck by Russian missiles; apartments in a high-rise damaged, one killed, injuries being clarified per Dnipropetrovsk OVA. (Source: @UkraineNow/83027)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Yurchenkovo in Kharkiv region by 'North' group. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32041)
